transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Um... yeah. Hi. I guess... well, it's my eating. It's just been really weird lately. Like, I'll go a whole day and just... forget to eat. And then other times, I'm up past midnight just eating everything... takeout, snacks, whatever. It kind of freaked me out a little, so... that's why I'm here.
When you find yourself eating a lot late at night, do you feel like you can't stop or control how much you're eating?
Uh... no, not really. I don't think it's like that. I just... get hungry and I eat. I could stop if I wanted to, I guess. I just... don't.
After you've eaten a lot, especially late at night, do you feel guilty, upset, or ashamed about it?
Um... no. Not really. I don't... I don't really think about it like that. I just eat and then go to sleep.
Do you find yourself eating large amounts of food even when you’re not really hungry?

Uh... no. I don't think so. If I'm eating, it's usually 'cause I'm hungry. I mean, since I forget to eat during the day... my stomach's pretty empty by the time I actually get around to it. So... yeah.
When you eat, do you find yourself eating much more quickly than usual or eating until you feel uncomfortably full?
Uh... no. Not really. I just eat normal, I guess. I don't think I eat faster than anyone else... and I don't eat till I'm sick or anything. I just eat until I'm done.
Do you ever eat alone because you're embarrassed about how much you're eating?
No. Um... I don't really care if people are around. I'm not embarrassed or anything. I just... I just eat.
Do your eating habits ever cause you distress, or do they interfere with your daily life in any way?
No. I mean, it's just eating. It doesn't really get in the way of anything. I don't think about it that much.
